title: Yoppa's "Go" is an on fire record that is just in time for the Summer
htmlContent:
Yoppa's "Go" is an on fire record that is just in time for the Summer. It encompasses everything people want to hear in the music, with a digestible sound the masses can eat up and enjoy from this amazing creative. The music goes beyond nice audio but a complete experience of music that will set off any day to bring more joy to the world with every listen.
